solves.reason: P1: prefer (vs avoid). P2: pervasive (vs negligible). P5: unauthorized (vs legitimate). All original words.
P3: conform (vs rebel) — standard others should conform to. P4: holistic (vs partial). P6: neutral (vs biased).
P7: hypothetical (vs actual). P9: energetic (vs minimal). P11: depressed (vs elevated).
② generalized is wrong — text says 'specialized and divided their work'. specialized is correct.
① minimal is wrong — 'The natural differences...are enormous' supported by Oscar Wilde anecdote.
④ reinforce is wrong — 'do not disrupt the white supremacy'. disrupt means to break apart.
mortified — strongly ashamed/embarrassed. Contrasts with 'think nothing of' reading pirated versions.
strenuously — forcefully/vigorously. Context: objected strongly, then rebelled and took the offensive.
alleviate — reduce/lessen. Urban agriculture to alleviate climate change and biodiversity loss.
elects = chooses. The newspaper chooses to print only one story (gatekeeping).
comprised = composed. 'comprised of bits' = 'composed of bits'.
targeting = aiming at. Individuals targeting sustainability = aiming at sustainability.
pervasive (widespread) ↔ rare. widespread/dominant/persistent are all similar to pervasive.
profitable ↔ ruinous. beneficial/valuable/rewarding are all positive like profitable.
(A) shed light on = provide understanding/clarity. (B) light = not heavy (suitcase context).
guilds — specifically medieval trade associations. Collegia = Roman era, not Middle Ages.
Adjective needed before 'rationales': pathology (noun) → pathological (adjective).
Noun needed in parallel with 'program design' and 'site design and operation': develop → development.
Digital images = one more step removed from reality. The text argues photography is interpretation, digital even more so.
Animal psychologists insisted psychology was 'a study of behavior' — their main counter-argument to 'science of consciousness'.
